title: Waqt Ki Baatein - 2D Nostalgic Autumn Romance
caption:
Tujhme na kami koi hai, bas tera ye din bura hai... Waqt ki ye baatein hain, ise gujar jaane do. 🍂🚆💛

Golden train sunset, cold autumn wind, and a shared woolen scarf that makes everything feel safe. A gentle reminder for anyone having a heavy week: bad days don't define your forever. 🧣✨

Save this reel for when your heart needs comfort at 2 AM. 🎧🤍
